verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's first-party docs say users can run Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks. Its Flights product is described as handling the Python runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging, and versioning, and as running Python jobs built by your favorite agent and deployed in MotherDuck. That covers the core of AI-native recurring workflows. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how schedules are defined (cron or trigger syntax, retries, failure alerts), evidence of agent- or MCP-driven schedule creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights scheduling.
